name: hson-language
description: Syntax highlighting and authoritative diagnostics for HSON files and supported HSON tagged templates.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax tooling works in Restricted Mode. Trusted Schema diagnostics execute project code only with Workspace Trust and explicit enablement.

scripts.test: npm run test:grammar && npm run test:unit && npm run test:settings
scripts.test:baseline:installed: npm run package:vsix && node ./scripts/build-tests.mjs && HSON_BASELINE_VSIX=hson-language.vsix node ./tests/integration/run-baseline.mjs
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out hson-language.vsix

hson.appearance.libraryMarkerStrength.title: Library Marker Strength
hson.appearance.libraryMarkerStrength.markdownDescription: Controls the visual presence of the four-color marker on official literal `hson` usage sites. Colors remain customizable through `workbench.colorCustomizations`.

hson.appearance.authoringMarkerStrength.title: Authoring Marker Strength
hson.appearance.authoringMarkerStrength.markdownDescription: Controls the softer visual presence of the four-color marker on official literal `HSON` usage sites, including validation calls and tagged templates.

hson.appearance.blue.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty value or a hexadecimal color such as #69B8EE.
hson.appearance.blue.title: Blue
hson.appearance.blue.markdownDescription: Optional shared blue hue for the `h` and `H` markers. Leave empty to use the independently tuned theme colors and `workbench.colorCustomizations` IDs.

hson.appearance.yellow.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty value or a hexadecimal color such as #F2D064.
hson.appearance.yellow.title: Yellow
hson.appearance.yellow.markdownDescription: Optional shared yellow hue for the `s` and `S` markers. Leave empty to use the independently tuned theme colors and `workbench.colorCustomizations` IDs.

hson.appearance.orange.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty value or a hexadecimal color such as #F18BA8.
hson.appearance.orange.title: Orange
hson.appearance.orange.markdownDescription: Optional shared orange/pink hue for the `o` and `O` markers. Leave empty to use the independently tuned theme colors and `workbench.colorCustomizations` IDs.

hson.appearance.green.patternErrorMessage: Use an empty value or a hexadecimal color such as #6CCA96.
hson.appearance.green.title: Green
hson.appearance.green.markdownDescription: Optional shared green hue for the `n` and `N` markers. Leave empty to use the independently tuned theme colors and `workbench.colorCustomizations` IDs.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.enabled.title: Trusted Execution
hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Allows HSON trusted Schema diagnostics to execute the selected project's code, including Schema definitions, constraints, recurse callbacks, and module initialization. Execution occurs only in a VS Code-trusted workspace, after separate HSON consent, and runs with your user permissions in a supervised separate process. This is not a security sandbox.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.module.title: Provider Entry
hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.module.description: Trusted Schema registration module path, resolved relative to the containing workspace folder. Prefer a Schema-only module, not the application entrypoint.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.hsonModule.title: HSON Runtime Module
hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.hsonModule.description: Advanced: path to the project's hson.js facade, resolved relative to the containing workspace folder. It must be the same runtime instance used by the provider.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.runtimeEnt.title: Runtime Entry
hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.runtimeEnt.description: Advanced: private trusted-diagnostics Node entry path relative to the workspace folder. When empty, HSON uses the entry beside the configured HSON runtime module.

hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.execArgv.title: Node Arguments
hson.trustedSchemaDiagnostics.execArgv.description: Advanced: Node loader arguments required by the trusted provider, for example when executing development TypeScript modules.

colors.description: HSON library facade marker: h (strong blue).
HSON library facade marker: s (strong yellow).
HSON library facade marker: o (strong pink).
HSON library facade marker: n (strong green).
